title: Li et al. 2011, MNRAS 412, 1441 — Nearby Supernova Rates from LOSS III (volume-limited sample of 175 SNe)
content: We derive the observed fractions for the different subclasses in a complete SN sample, and find significant fractions of SNe II-L (10%), IIb (12%), and IIn (9%) in the SN II sample. We select a volume-limited sample of 175 SNe ... cutoff distance ... 60 Mpc for SNe Ibc and II.
